legal.draft: Draft summary for development. The full legal text will replace this page before release.
legal.termsPlansText: Dreamy Stories Premium is offered as a weekly or a yearly auto-renewing subscription. Prices are shown in your local currency by the App Store or Google Play before you confirm.
legal.termsRenewalText: Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled in App Store or Google Play settings. Payment is charged to your store account when you confirm the purchase, and again at the start of each period.
legal.termsCancelText: You can cancel at any time in your App Store or Google Play subscription settings. Access continues until the end of the period you have paid for.
legal.termsFreeText: A selection of stories stays free to read with every reader feature, with or without a subscription.
legal.privacyNoAccountText: Dreamy Stories has no sign-up, no advertising and no third-party tracking.
legal.privacyDeviceText: Reading progress and preferences are stored only on this device.
legal.privacyPurchasesText: Payments are handled entirely by the App Store or Google Play. Dreamy Stories never sees your payment details.
